description: This file defines functions for creating and managing asynchronous database connections using SQLAlchemy in an async context. It includes functions to create an async engine, a session factory, and a FastAPI dependency for providing database sessions.

methods.name: AsyncEngine create_engine(settings: Settings)
methods.description: Creates and returns an asynchronous SQLAlchemy engine using provided settings.

methods.name: async_sessionmaker[AsyncSession] create_session_factory(engine: AsyncEngine)
methods.description: Creates and returns an async sessionmaker configured with the given engine.

methods.name: AsyncIterator[AsyncSession] get_db_session(session_factory: async_sessionmaker[AsyncSession])
methods.description: Asynchronous generator function that provides an AsyncSession, suitable as a FastAPI dependency, ensuring proper session cleanup after use.
